definitions.explanation: A large domesticated mammal used for riding and transport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{馬|うま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、{馬|うま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦みたかった→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I wanted to try riding a horse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、{馬|うま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In the past in Japan, horses were used to carry people and goods.

notes:
{馬|うま} is the standard word for horse.

PRONUNCIATION:
- うま: standalone word and kun'yomi
- ば: in on'yomi compounds (⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧, ⟦{馬車|ばしゃ}→馬車：14638_basha⟧)
- ま: in some compounds ({馬|ま}⟦{小屋|ごや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧: horse racing
- ⟦{馬車|ばしゃ}→馬車：14638_basha⟧: horse-drawn carriage
- ⟦{馬力|ばりき}→馬力：14653_bariki⟧: horsepower (also used figuratively)
- ⟦{子馬|こうま}→子馬：19287_kouma⟧: foal, pony
- ⟦{乗馬|じょうば}→乗馬：17123_jouba⟧: horseback riding

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {馬|うま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to get along well (lit. "horses match")
- {馬|うま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{念仏|ねんぶつ}→念仏：12850_nenbutsu⟧: wasted advice on someone who won't listen (lit. "a prayer to a horse's ear")
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧: fool, idiot (originally written with the kanji for horse and deer)

COUNTER:
Horses are counted with ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧: ⟦{一頭|いっとう}→一頭：noentry⟧、⟦{二頭|にとう}→二頭：noentry⟧.
